newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 978 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 978 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade's Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totaled 978 contracts, according to the CBOT.

There were 63 wheat contracts, 473 corn, 416 soybean, 12 soymeal, 6 soyoil and 8 oats futures contracts traded, along with 2 wheat call, 2 corn call, 3 corn put, 36 soybean call, and 11 soybean put options.

The overnight trend for corn was steady to down 1/4 cents per bushel, soybeans up 1-3/4 to 2 cents, wheat up 3/4 to down 1/4 cent, soymeal steady to up $1.10 a ton, soyoil steady to up 0.08 cent per lb, and oats down 3/4 cent a bushel.
